checklists.name: Pre-production checklist
items: Logline + one-sentence emotional promise of the film
Beat sheet: hook (0–10s) → setup → escalation → reversal → button image
Shot list with one job per shot (framing + single camera move + action)
Style bible locked (one style line; aspect ratio; grain/grade; lens language)
Character lock: identity method chosen (Soul ID / Cameo / reference sheet / labels); training photos or sheets prepared
Location/world lock: reference images or Soul Location generations saved
Audio plan: music direction (Suno prompts), voice cast (ElevenLabs voices), SFX needs; radio edit script drafted
Budget: credits per clip estimated from live model table; reroll budget (×3–5 per hero shot); plan tier vs. credit math
Rights: no real faces/voices as inputs (festival rule); AI-audio rights held; likeness permissions for Soul ID training
Delivery spec confirmed: ratio (16:9/21:9 festival; 9:16 social), MP4/MOV, up to 4K, watermark/packshot if festival

checklists.name: Per-shot checklist (before every generation)
items: One subject, one action, one camera move — nothing more
Identity Block vs Motion Block separated (no appearance in motion, no motion in identity)
Subject anchored with stable label or @ reference (never pronouns alone)
Camera phrasing explicit (move + speed + stability + purpose)
Lighting + style-bible line appended verbatim
Audio direction included if model supports native audio (dialogue quoted + attributed; SFX named)
Negative/exclusion handled per model (Runway: none — state desired; Seedance: exclude compositionally)
Draft at 720p / Fast tier first; hero only after approval
Duration matched to complexity (short = tighter consistency)

checklists.name: Consistency checklist
items: Same character description word-for-word across all prompts (or Soul ID / Cameo / Elements selected)
Character sheet composite available as @Image1 for new angles
Last frame of previous clip = start frame of next (relay chaining) OR explicit FLF pair
Re-anchor original references every few chained generations (don't wait for drift)
Style bible unchanged since shot 1
Wardrobe/props continuity verified per shot (front/rear split sheets for hero props)
Faces: check for drift, merging (multi-person), plasticky wide-shot faces → fix in post
Grade preview: stills from different models compared side-by-side before final renders

checklists.name: Audio checklist
items: Radio edit first: story works with eyes closed (dialogue/VO/music/SFX arc)
Dialogue: clean takes, processing chain (cleanup → high-pass/EQ → compress → de-ess → level)
Lip sync: correct route (native quotes in-video vs post tool); vocals isolated before lip-sync tools
Foley/SFX layers: backgrounds → hard FX → Foley; room tone under everything; J/L cuts on transitions
Music: generated, rights held; structure tags used; 3–4 versions auditioned
Mix: dialogue -16 to -14 LUFS; ambience -28 to -24 under dialogue; music bed -24 ducked -8 to -10 dB
Master: -14 LUFS integrated / -1 dBTP true peak (YouTube); alternate master if broadcast (-24)
QC: earbuds + speakers + mono check; no clipping; no over-denoised "booth" voices

checklists.name: Delivery checklist
items: Picture lock → color pass (kill AI over-saturation; unified LUT; grain; chromatic aberration)
VFX cleanup: face fixes, artifact removal, shake/motion to sell movement
Upscale ONLY final selects (Topaz to 4K; frame-rate tool if slow-mo needed)
On-screen text/titles added in post (never baked into generation)
Export: MP4/MOV, target resolution, correct ratio, audio master embedded
Festival (Higgsfield): watermark + packshot present; public post live on IG/YouTube/X/Reddit (public, no login); all generation on higgsfield.ai; audio AI-generated with rights
Archive: prompts, seeds, references, project files saved for open-source-style reproducibility
